title: Monitoring pipeline Terraform module for VPC: Prometheus + Grafana + OTEL + log-shipper
creator: Ava Singh
description: Create a reusable Terraform module that provisions a turnkey monitoring pipeline for Private/VPC deployments. The module will install Prometheus, Alertmanager, Grafana, an OpenTelemetry Collector service, and a log shipping agent (Vector or Fluent Bit) with sane defaults and optional integrations for KMS-backed secrets, S3/GCS long-term metrics/log archival, and helm/k8s provider flexibility. The goal is to support both EKS-like clusters and self-managed k8s on customer VPCs and to provide robust upgrade/health-check automation so platform operators can safely roll out changes in Dedicated/Private environments.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module exposes inputs for operator-controlled values: prometheus_retention, grafana_admin_secret_arn, otel_collector_image, log_shipper_type, storage_class, replicas
Module supports two deployment modes: helm_release (k8s provider) and rendered_manifest (for non-helm flows) via a toggle variable
Default installation config passes a preflight plan: CRDs validated, PVC snapshot for Prometheus data optional, and OTEL config syntax check
Upgrade path allows canary helm release and automatic rollback if health checks fail
Module publishes outputs: prometheus_endpoint, grafana_endpoint, alertmanager_endpoint, otel_collector_endpoint, log_shipper_endpoint
Module includes health-checking terraform null_resource that runs post-deploy probe scripts and fails when critical checks are unhealthy
Documentation with example Terragrunt overlay and a smoke-test script is added to infra-modules repo
Automated tests in CI run linting (tflint), unit plan tests (terratest/terraform-compliance), and a smoke deploy against a dev cluster
tasks: Design Terraform module API and variable names (variables.tf) and document in README
Implement Helm provider path using stable/bitnami or prometheus-community/kube-prometheus-stack chart
Implement rendered_manifest path using k8s_manifest resources for air-gapped customers
Add support for log_shipper_type variable: vector | fluentbit; provide prebuilt config templates
Add optional KMS-backed secret integration for Grafana admin and Alertmanager hooks
Create post-deploy health checks (HTTP probes for /metrics, /api/health, Grafana login test) as null_resource provisioner
Add pre-upgrade hooks: export minimal prometheus TSDB snapshot and backup Grafana dashboards to S3 if enabled
Write CI pipelines: plan, apply to ephemeral dev cluster, run smoke tests, and destroy
Add docs and examples for Terragrunt overlays per environment (dev/stage/prod)
design_decisions: Use OpenTelemetry Collector as the standard path for traces/metrics and to allow unified routing to vendor backends
Prefer kube-prometheus-stack helm chart as default for operator convenience; provide a rendered manifest option for customers that disallow helm
Log shipping will default to Vector for richer transforms, with Fluent Bit as a lightweight alternative where container footprint matters
Health checks implemented as a terraform null_resource that invokes a small runner script stored in repo (bash/python) to keep terraform plan/apply deterministic
Module will not attempt to migrate historical TSDB data automatically during upgrades; instead produce a snapshot and provide a documented restore path to reduce migration complexity
rollout_plan: 1) Merge module into infra-modules main branch behind feature flag. 2) Release v0.1.0 to staging registry. 3) Deploy to infra-dev cluster and run smoke tests (prometheus scrape, grafana login, otel push). 4) Deploy to private-demo customer VPC with operator oversight. 5) Monitor health checks for 48h; if stable, publish v0.1.0 README and announce to platform teams.
upgrade_strategy: When bumping chart or collector versions, module will perform a blue/green style helm release where possible: create new helm release with suffix -canary (or use helm canary annotations), wait for all readiness and health checks to pass for 10 minutes, then switch traffic by updating service selectors or flipping a k8s Service. Terraform will run pre-upgrade snapshot for Prometheus TSDB if storage class supports snapshots. If health checks fail, terraform will abort and trigger rollback of canary release. For rendered_manifest mode, we will apply a new manifest with unique names and then switch endpoints via k8s Service swapping. All upgrade steps documented and automated in the module's upgrade.sh helper script.
health_checks: Alertmanager: /-/ready and push_webhook health endpoints must be reachable
Grafana: Login with admin secret and verify /api/health returns 'OK'
OTEL Collector: /v1/metrics and /metrics endpoints respond and collector config passes otelcol config check
Log shippers: tail test log injected to verify pipeline to chosen sink (local ES or S3)
test_plan: Unit: tflint and terraform validate on module
Integration: Terratest deploy to ephemeral k3s cluster in CI with Helm path and rendered_manifest path
Smoke: Post-deploy probes executed from GitHub Actions runner located in same VPC region to verify network egress and endpoint reachability
Chaos: Simulate node reboot and ensure autoscaling/restoration of stateful components (Prometheus replicas) within SLO
Security: Verify Grafana admin password encryption via KMS and ensure secrets are not leaked in state files

Encourage platform teams to use the rendered_manifest mode for locked-down environments but document its limitations (no helm lifecycle hooks).
